Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Redwood  annotated DPA redline + SCCs evidence matrix

Hi Amir / Hearthwell Legal -

Attached are: 1) an annotated redline of your DPA with our proposed edits (Redwood_DPA_annotated.pdf); 2) a short SCCs_evidence_matrix.xlsx mapping each required clause to operational evidence; and 3) a concise transfer-impact addendum draft that we propose to attach to the MSA if you prefer not to import our full baseline.

Summary of material proposals in the redline: 
- Transfer safeguards: we accept SCCs and will include a transfer-impact addendum that documents (i) boundaries of data flows (inference payloads only), (ii) controls applied at host and orchestration layers, (iii) KV-cache handling and TTLs, and (iv) encryption at rest for snapshot/backups.
- Subprocessors: Redwood proposes a 30-day notice period with an objection window capped at 15 days and objective grounds for objection (data localization, access to decrypt plaintext, or known high-risk processor).
- Liability / liability cap carveouts: proposed limited carveouts for willful misconduct and negligence tied to transfer failure; see clause 9.3 in redline.
- Audit & evidence: we propose a quarterly evidence package (SCCs matrix + recent SOC 2 summary) and an on-site/audit alternative for high-risk customers.

Open asks for Hearthwell counsel: 
1) Are the proposed objective grounds for subprocessor objection acceptable?
2) Would Hearthwell prefer Redwoods transfer-impact addendum attached to the MSA or edits directly integrated into Hearthwell's DPA?

I've included inline annotations where we think language can be tightened. Happy to walk through on Friday's call.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Privacy Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
[Attachments: Redwood_DPA_annotated.pdf, SCCs_evidence_matrix.xlsx, Transfer_Impact_Addendum_draft.docx]

- We prefer the transfer-impact addendum as a separate annex (cleaner for our legal ops).

We can take the redline offline and come back with line edits by Monday. The Friday slot works for a 30-min call; Amir and one in-house counsel will join.
